messages:
marta: Quick sync re: OpenModelCo — we need to lock NDA lift + embargo + marketplace hosting vs download decision. Who's got the final say on redistribution terms?

jules: I can take lead on the redistribution/license wording. main points: non-exclusive hosting OK, redistribution requires provenance clause, attribution, and export screening. will send redline by EOD.

kevin: Marketing: tentative launch window is 4/14–4/18. we need final logo assets and approved quote from OpenModelCo by Mon to hit that. embargo lift has to be 24h before the PR. :eyes:

marta: Noted. Jules — does the attribution requirement block marketplace download SKUs? OpenModelCo prefers hosted offering but may allow download with a stricter CL.

jules: Download adds compliance risk. If they permit download, require a redistribution addendum + customer attestations. Otherwise we can offer a hosted-only SKU and a separate partner-managed download option (legal paperwork).

anya: Engineering: hosted-only is easiest from infra/security POV. For download we need signed distro manifest and an automated expiry script for license revocation. also need clarity on KMS/HSM requirements if keys are involved.

sam: SI partners (CoreSys & GreyBox) need at least 2 weeks to validate infra and do cert tests. Can we confirm hosting decision by this Friday? that gives SI time before the mid-April launch.

kevin: If we aim for hosted-only, marketing ramps the co-branded blog + partner webinar. If download is allowed, messaging becomes more complex — need clear buyer guidance. prefer hosted-only.

marta: ok, hosted-only seems to be the path of least resistance. Jules — can you produce the hosted-only redline and a short addendum template for enterprise download buyers?

jules: Yep. I'll attach two artifacts: 1) "Hosted Use License (redline)" 2) "Enterprise Download Addendum (template)". ETA: EOD Fri.

kevin: marketing ask: can OpenModelCo provide a 1–2 sentence embargo quote and a 150-word technical blurb? also a high-res logo with clear usage rights. need sizing guidance for the marketplace tile.

marta: pinging OpenModelCo contact in thread — @openmodelco / cc: @pm-rep — please confirm quote + assets timeline.

launch-bot: Scheduled launch window reserved: 2026-04-15 09:00 PT — reserve slot confirmed. Use /release to lock.

sam: Two operational items: 1) Marketplace SKU metadata: name, description, hosting region tags (US, EU), billing metric (tokens vs requests). 2) SI integration checklist: certs, smoke tests, rollback plan. I'll draft templates.

anya: For billing metric — suggest tokens for hosted gen and vector-embedding calls. We'll expose a toggle: burst capacity on/off for dedicated partners. Also need to confirm model quant sizes for autoscaler.

marta: Good call. Kevin — can marketing sign off on the messaging that this is "hosted-only" with optional private download under strict enterprise terms?

kevin: Yes, but need to soften language: "primarily hosted, with enterprise download available under controlled terms" — helps sales.

jules: One more legal flag: export controls. We need a short questionnaire for buyers (country of domicile, export-controlled uses). I'll add it to the addendum template.

marta: Sam/Anya — please include a short gate in the SI checklist that enforces legal clearance for regions flagged in the questionnaire.

sam: Will do. Re: timeline — if Jules delivers EOD Fri and OpenModelCo gives assets Mon, SI validation complete by 4/9, then marketing + legal signoff -> launch 4/15 looks feasible.

kevin: Can we run a dry-run internal announcement 4/13? quick slide + PR draft. volunteers: me, sam, marta.

marta: volunteers confirmed. Also need to confirm the partner webinar host (OpenModelCo engineer + Redwood PM).

anya: Tech note — for the marketplace tile we need a 2-minute demo video (720p) and a short inference sample. I can produce the sample once we have model endpoint and sample prompt set.

marta: Action items summary (quick):
- Jules: Hosted Use License redline + enterprise addendum + export questionnaire (EOD Fri)
- OpenModelCo: 1–2 sentence quote, 150-word blurb, high-res logo (by Mon)
- Sam: SI checklist + marketplace metadata template (by Tue)
- Anya: sample inference, demo stub (after endpoint ready)
- Kevin: PR draft + slide deck + dry-run 4/13 (draft by 4/10)

kevin: :thumbsup: I'll draft PR language that emphasizes controlled hosting and enterprise options.

jules: I'll drop the redlines into the shared folder: /shared/partnerships/openmodelco/legal/ — ping me if you can't access.

marta: Thanks all. If anyone sees blockers (export, IP, or SI capacity) call it out early here.

sam: Noted — I'll escalate SI capacity if smoke tests show perf regressions.

openmodelco-person: thanks team — we'll aim to get assets to you by Mon and confirm the hosted-only preference internally. looking forward to finalizing the addendum.

marta: Great — staying on this thread. End state target: sign-off and embargo lift 24h before 2026-04-15 09:00 PT.

kevin: Added: can we get a partner quote cleared for external use in writing? Legal prefers it in email.

jules: yes, request email confirmation from OpenModelCo legal. that'll satisfy audit.

marta: Cool — closing for now, will reopen if any of the timelines slip. :rocket:
